item.title: Improvised Explosive Thrown At Anti-Islam Event In NYC, Police Say
item.description: Associated Press NEW YORK (AP) — A device thrown by a counter-protester at an anti-Islam demonstration in New York City on Saturday was confirmed to be an improvised explosive, according to a preliminary police analysis. item.title: Crude Oil Prices Surpass $100 A Barrel As The Iran War Impedes Production And Shipping
item.description: By ALEX VEIGA AP Business Writer CHICAGO (AP) — Oil prices have eclipsed $100 per barrel for the first time in more than three and a half years as the Iran war hinders production and shipping in the Middle East. The price for a barrel of Brent crude, the international standard, was at $101.19 shortly after trading resumed on the Chicago Mercantile Exchange, up 9.2% from its settlement price of $92.69 Friday. item.title: Kansas City Airport Reopens Hours After An Evacuation As A Potential Threat Was Investigated
item.description: (AP) — The Kansas City International Airport terminal reopened Sunday afternoon, hours after it was evacuated while authorities looked into a potential threat, the Kansas City Aviation Department said. Airport spokesperson Jackson Overstreet said in an email shortly after 2 p.m. that the terminal was reopened. item.title: NTSB Member Says He Was Fired Without Explanation By The Trump Administration
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — A National Transportation Safety Board member who was a public face of the investigation into last year’s deadly collision of an airliner and an Army helicopter near the nation’s capital said Sunday that he had been fired by the Trump administration without explanation. item.title: Police In Norway Investigate An Explosion Outside The US Embassy In Oslo
item.description: By STEFANIE DAZIO and MATTHEW LEE Associated Press Police in Norway were investigating an explosion early Sunday outside the U.S. Embassy in Oslo, the capital of the Scandinavian country, officials said. No injuries were reported. Police received reports of a “loud bang” or explosion around 1 a.m., Oslo police said in a news release. item.description: By BASSEM MROUE Associated Press ZAHLE, Lebanon (AP) — A retired Lebanese security officer vanished in December after going to meet a possible buyer for a plot of land. item.description: By DAVE COLLINS, STEVE KARNOWSKI and MIKE HOUSEHOLDER Associated Press UNION CITY, Mich. item.title: Poll Shows Majority Of Voters Disapprove Of Trump’s Handling Of Iran
item.description: A majority of registered voters disapprove of President Trump’s handling of the situation Iran. According to an NBC News poll, 54 percent of the voters are unhappy with the situation compared to 41 percent who approve. More than half of those polled specifically said the U.S. should not have taken military action. Pollsters note support for the White House is mostly polarized along party lines. item.title: Gas Prices Jump Again
item.description: Gas prices continue to rise. Triple A reports the national average is now three-dollars and 45-cents a gallon, up from Saturday’s three-41. The jump comes amid ongoing U.S. military operations in Iran. That’s been wreaking havoc in oil markets and causing pain at the pump for drivers across the country.
